description: This file defines the NumberFormatter class, which provides methods for formatting numeric values into various string representations, including handling complex number formats, scientific notation, and various locale-aware features. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the style/number format submodule.

classes.name: NumberFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting numeric values according to specified formats, handling complex masks, scientific notation, thousands separators, and scaling for the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks
methods.description: Merges the integer and decimal parts of complex number format masks into cohesive masks for processing.

methods.name: processComplexNumberFormatMask
methods.description: Processes a number according to a complex mask, injecting parts of the number into the mask pattern.

methods.name: complexNumberFormatMask
methods.description: Formats a number based on complex mask rules, splitting integer and fractional parts, and applying complex formatting.

methods.name: f2s
methods.description: Converts a float value to a string, using scientific notation if appropriate.

methods.name: floatStringConvertScientific
methods.description: Converts a scientific notation string into a normalized string form, handling both exponent positive and negative cases.

methods.name: formatStraightNumericValue
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a string based on a simple numeric format string, handling scientific notation and padding.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main method to format a value according to a given number format string, with handling for currency, scientific notation, and locale-specific features.

methods.name: makeString
methods.description: Converts a value to a string if it is not already an array.

methods.name: pregReplace
methods.description: A wrapper around preg_replace to handle null results and ensure string output.

methods.name: padValue
methods.description: Pads a formatted value to match the width specified by the format, considering decimal and integer parts.

methods.name: areThousandsRequired
methods.description: Detects whether thousand separators are needed in a format string and removes the separator placeholders.

methods.name: scaleThousandsMillions
methods.description: Determines scaling factor (thousands, millions, etc.) based on commas in the format string and removes those commas.
